group_assessment.weighting: A conceptual narrative review without a methods section or search strategy; it advances a unifying 'chloride microdomain' hypothesis across epilepsy, neuropathic pain and schizophrenia and states some conclusions as universal. Its own text admits direct characterisation of chloride microdomains in human brain is technically challenging. WWOX does not appear anywhere. Read here only for whether it measures anything that could settle the 'depolarising GABA' question the working model records as unmeasured; it does not.

entries.proposition: The review has no methods section and no stated search; the Conclusions invite the reader to treat it as a framework.
entries.snippet: We intend this review to serve as both a foundation and invitation

entries.proposition: The review concedes direct characterisation of chloride microdomains in the human brain is technically challenging.
entries.snippet: it remains technically challenging to directly characterize chloride microdomains in the human brain

entries.proposition: The epilepsy section asserts a single mechanism for all epilepsy types, a universal claim not supported by a measurement in the review.
entries.snippet: Epilepsy, regardless of type, occurs by the exact same mechanisms.

entries.proposition: Immature neurons are described as more seizure-prone because of high NKCC1.
entries.snippet: the developing brain has a greater potential for producing seizures due to the high levels of NKCC1

entries.proposition: NKCC1 modulation is described as moving toward selective, context-dependent approaches; a string search of the rendered text on 2026-10-19 for 'bumetanide', 'NEMO' and 'trial' returned no hit, so no clinical trial result is cited.
entries.snippet: The therapeutic approaches to modulate NKCC1 are transitioning toward selective and context-dependent methods.

entries.proposition: The authors acknowledge their conclusions may seem premature.
entries.snippet: If our conclusions seem premature, it may be due to the fact that much remains to be learned

entries.proposition: Disease convergence is stated as a hypothesis.
entries.snippet: we hypothesize that chloride may play a unifying physiological role in all of these diseases
